title: Privacy guard operator: adaptive scrubbers, hierarchical retention, and immutable audit trail
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a privacy 'guard operator' that enforces tenant-aware telemetry policies across tracing hooks, metrics/log pipelines, and dashboard exports. The operator will: 1) distribute redaction and pseudonymization policies to collectors and tracing hooks, 2) enforce hierarchical retention (per-tenant -> per-route -> per-signal), 3) record an immutable access and policy-change audit trail, and 4) provide a safe rollout path to avoid data loss for in-flight telemetry.

Scope: first iteration targets trace and log pipelines (OTLP/Jaeger/Fluent) and the metrics ingestion pipeline (Prometheus remote write). We will implement dynamic scrubber plugins (regex + ML classifier fallback) at collectors and a retention enforcer that applies TTLs at ingestion and compaction. The operator will expose a CRD-style config and a Console UI surface to visualize active policies and recent redaction actions.

Non-goals: this ticket does not implement full end-user masking on stored artifacts (that will be separate), and does not cover KMS/HSM integration for field-level encryption (planned in follow-up).

Design highlights:
- Policy model: JSON policy documents with scopes (tenant, route, dataset), sensitivity level tags (low/medium/high), and redact actions (mask, remove, hash, pseudonymize).
- Enforcement points: collector-side (preferred) and gateway-side fallback. Collectors run adaptive scrubbers that keep a rolling false-positive/false-negative score and report metrics.
- Auditing: every policy change and every privileged access to raw telemetry generates an immutable audit event written to the audit store (append-only S3 prefix with object versioning) and surfaceable in Console with RBAC filters.
- Retention: operator converts TTLs into lifecycle rules in the object store and retention flags in the timeseries DB; metrics with high sensitivity will be rolled up (aggregate) rather than stored at full cardinality.
- Rollout: phased canary - start with synthetic traffic and internal tenant, then 10% of customers with monitoring, then global. During canary the operator will run in "observe" mode where scrubbers report what they'd remove without modifying payloads.

Acceptance criteria:
- Operator can distribute and apply a sample policy to collectors in two regions.
- Console shows policy graph and last 7 days of redaction events for a tenant.
- Audit trail contains policy changes and access logs with tamper-evidence (versioned objects + signed manifests).
- No more than 0.5% increase in p50 latency for trace ingestion in canary.
- Documentation and runbook for rollback and incident response.

Implementation plan (high-level):
1) Policy schema and operator prototype (k8s operator + lightweight API) - ENG-55802
2) Collector scrubber plugin (Go) with regex and ML hooks; observe-mode implementation - ENG-55803
3) Retention enforcer that translates TTLs to object lifecycle and DB policies - ENG-55804
4) Audit pipeline and immutable storage design - ENG-55805
5) Console UI surface and RBAC filters - ENG-55806
6) Canary, metrics, and rollout (SRE/Prod Infra involvement) - ENG-55807

Risks & mitigations:
- Over-scrubbing: mitigate with observe-mode and an operator-managed "whitelist" for critical fields.
- Performance regression: collect detailed perf metrics; fall back to gateway-based scrubbers if needed.
- Policy propagation delays: operator will support versioned policy checkpoints and wait-for-ack semantics.

updates: 2026-02-16 - Kickoff: scoped MVP to traces/logs, confirmed SRE and Console owners. Asha outlined operator schema; Marco to lead collector plugin.
2026-02-22 - Prototype operator created (control plane skeleton). Added observe-mode flag and versioned policy API. PR opened: platform#1289.
2026-03-01 - Collector scrubber PoC shows 0.3% p50 latency increase on internal trace generator; ML fallback introduced to reduce false positives.
2026-03-05 - Security review requested; working with Compliance (ticket COMPL-72). Decided audit store must use versioned S3 and signed manifests for tamper evidence.
2026-03-10 - UX sync: Console team agreed to a read-only policy graph for canary, with full edit locked to org-admins. Need RBAC mapping from identity service.

2026-03-12 - Blocker found: existing metric compaction path doesn't expose per-tenant rollup hooks. Assigned follow-up to ENG-55809. Moving forward with trace/log canary while compaction work proceeds.
